notes.general_comments:
Compared to previous papers, more candidates drew clear diagrams to help with their solutions and aid the
clear presentation of their work.
Most candidates gave their answers to the required accuracy and few candidates used premature
approximations. On this paper g = 10 should be used and few candidates used g = 9.8 or 9.81. The
formulae list can be used by candidates to check that they are using the correct formula.
